notes: Item 19 discloses Gross Revenue for 132 franchised businesses open more than one year as of end of fiscal year 2025 (one unit excluded: Wexler, Maryland). Four metrics extracted: average, median, highest, and lowest gross revenue. The cohort_name 'open_12_24mo' is used as the cohort qualifier is 'more than one year open' with no upper tenure bound stated, but the system only had 133 total units at year-end so the practical tenure range is mixed; the most accurate available cohort descriptor given the schema is open_12_24mo as the defining criterion is a minimum of one year open. Gross Revenue is defined as total invoiced revenue before deductions for expenses, royalties, or marketing fees, not net of refunds or taxes. Data not independently audited.
